articles.title: Google unveils new agentic commerce protocol for retailers
articles.mainIdea: Google unveils new agentic commerce protocol for retailers
articles.summary: American Banker: Google unveils new agentic commerce protocol for retailers. Universal Commerce Protocol is an open standard that establishes a common language for AI agents and systems to work together, and will allow consumers to purchase products from retailers directly through Google's AI Mode in the browser or the Gemini app. Related tickers mentioned: GOOG.
